title: Alternate-flight offers when a fare sells out
desc: When a customer's search returns a sold-out fare or the last seat in a cabin, 29% of those sessions are abandoned and the revenue goes to competitors. Surface alternate flights, nearby dates and comparable fares the moment a result comes back unavailable, with fare-display rules applied, while staying inside DOT consumer-protection and PCI guardrails at checkout.

title: Book in-cabin pets online
desc: Customers can't add a pet to a booking online, so they call (40-minute holds), pay the pet fee at the airport, or find out at the gate that the in-cabin pet limit was reached. Let travelers add an in-cabin pet while booking, with live per-flight pet availability, carrier size rules and the fee shown up front.

Shape>Prototype:m-compliance-which-rules.note: Pets in cabin are not ACAA service animals; keep service-animal flow separate. DOT fee display rules apply to the pet fee.

title: Live upgrade-list position and clear alerts
desc: AAdvantage members can't see where they stand on the upgrade list until the gate, don't get told when an upgrade clears, and see their position jump without explanation. Show live position and the reason for it in the app, and push an alert the moment an upgrade clears or the list moves.

title: Wheelchair assistance that follows the passenger
desc: Wheelchair and mobility-assistance requests get lost when a trip is rebooked or a gate changes, so passengers wait at the gate or miss connections. Carry the request through every change and alert the assistance team at each station in real time. This is an ACAA accessibility commitment, not only a service gap.

title: Mobile boarding pass that works offline
desc: Mobile boarding passes fail at the gate: blank QR codes, logouts at boarding, wallet passes that won't save, stale gates after a change. Make the boarding pass work offline and keep the wallet pass in sync, so nobody walks back to the counter.

title: Proactive shipment status for cargo shippers
desc: Shippers learn about missed connections and status gaps from their consignees, not from us, and track freight by calling stations. Send proactive shipment alerts and give shippers one live status page per air waybill.

Sense>Shape:m-size-it-who-s-affected-how.note: ~6% of search sessions end in a second visit within 72h; competitor fee $7.99

title: Fare lock for price-sensitive travelers
desc: A competitor launched a 72-hour fare lock and price-sensitive travelers who are not ready to pay are leaving search to hold fares elsewhere. Let customers hold a fare for a small fee, so they come back to book with us instead of a rival.

title: Delayed-bag delivery tracking for customers
desc: When a bag is delayed, customers file a report and then hear nothing until a courier calls. Show the delayed bag's location, the flight it is on and the delivery window, with alerts at each step, so customers stop calling to ask where it is.

title: Baggage mishandling alerts
